author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Fortress tower mirrored about x=24: full-width battlement with three merlons and two crenels (all exactly 8), rounded lower block corners stepping into a narrower body with rounded foot corners, as in the reference. Lucide castle construction (crenellated top).
omissions: On HRECT_L it is wider than the reference: three merlons and two crenels need 40 units at 8-unit spacing, more than the 36 a SQUARE allows.
